name: Allocation Donut
description: A portfolio allocation donut that morphs between asset class, region and sector, with target-drift ticks, a live centre readout and a synced legend.

props.name: views
props.type: { key: string; label: string; slices: AllocationSlice[] }[]
props.description: Groupings to switch between. Slices: { name, value, target?, change? }, up to 8, largest first so the accent lands on the biggest.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Key of the view shown first; defaults to the first.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: Drift in percentage points before a slice gets a drift chip.

name: Candlestick Chart
description: A trading-desk candlestick chart with a snapping crosshair, two moving averages, volume, live ticks, drag and pinch zoom and a draggable range navigator.

props.name: data
props.description: Candles per interval: { t: epoch ms, o, h, l, c, v }, oldest first. Missing intervals fall back to demo data.

props.name: pair
props.description: Pair shown in the mono chip.

props.name: venue
props.description: Exchange or data source, hidden in narrow containers.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for the headline price.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px; plots under 560px wide use 70%.

props.name: live
props.description: Tick the last candle every 1.4s. Ignored under reduced motion.

name: Analytics Dashboard
description: A calm store dashboard: KPI cards that drive a morphing SVG area chart with crosshair, 7/30/90-day ranges, channel bars and an orders table that turns into cards.

props.name: days
props.description: Daily { date, revenue, orders, sessions }, oldest first. Supply twice the longest range so every KPI has a previous period to compare with.

props.name: defaultMetric
props.description: KPI the main chart shows first. Clicking a KPI card switches it.

props.name: channels
props.description: Revenue share per channel for each range (0–1). Amounts are derived from the period's revenue.

props.name: orders
props.description: Recent orders: id, customer, items, channel, status (Paid | Fulfilled | Pending | Refunded), total, placed.

props.name: nav
props.type: { label: string; icon: DashboardNavIcon; href: string; badge?: string; active?: boolean }[]
props.description: Sidebar links. Icons are keys: overview, orders, products, customers, analytics, marketing, settings.

props.name: payout
props.type: { label: string; amount: string; note: string }
props.description: The payout card pinned to the bottom of the sidebar.

props.name: storeName
props.description: Workspace name in the sidebar and mobile top bar.

props.name: storeUrl
props.description: Secondary line under the store name.

props.name: user
props.description: Signed-in person at the foot of the sidebar.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Date and freshness line under the heading.

name: Sticky Scroll Story
description: A scroll-driven feature story on deep navy: a sticky product panel crossfades through four CSS-drawn states as the steps scroll past.
usage:
import { FeatureStickyScroll } from "@/components/design-for-ai/feature-sticky-scroll";

<FeatureStickyScroll
  brand="Ledgerly"
  heading="Bookkeeping that"
  headingItalic="does itself."
/>

props.name: headingItalic
props.description: Muted second clause of the heading.

props.name: steps
props.description: Four steps, each driving one panel state.

props.name: pots
props.description: Set-aside shares for the final state.

name: ASCII Wordmark Footer
description: A black footer whose giant wordmark is a canvas field of mono characters. The cursor is a lens: glyphs scramble, brighten and thicken beneath it.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The giant word. Rasterised with the display face at weight 800 and fitted to the full footer width. Words without descenders read best.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Lines used instead below 560px so the mark keeps enough rows to stay legible. Pass [] to keep one line.

props.name: signOff
props.description: One or two sentences above the wordmark, max 34ch.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; external?: boolean }[]
props.description: The compact link row. Hovering one dims its siblings.

props.name: legal
props.description: Mono legal line under the wordmark.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the hottest scrambling glyphs at the centre of the lens.

props.name: ramp
props.description: Density ramp, lightest first; the first character is empty space.

name: Kinetic Type Hero
description: A type foundry hero where every letter of a giant word stack gains weight and leans toward the cursor, with a slow wave on touch and a services marquee.

props.name: lines
props.description: The giant stack, one short line each.

name: Product Stack Hero
description: A light SaaS hero whose three CSS-drawn app windows (a calendar, a burndown and a comment thread) tilt toward the pointer in real 3D.
usage:
import { HeroProductStack } from "@/components/design-for-ai/hero-product-stack";

<HeroProductStack
  brand="Northstar"
  headline="Roadmaps your team will actually read."
  strike="actually"
  primary={{ label: "Try it free", href: "/signup" }}
/>

props.name: strike
props.description: Word set in the accent gradient.

props.name: events
props.description: Calendar blocks: day, start, hours, title, tone.

props.name: sprint
props.type: { name; left; status; actual: number[]; total }

name: Delivery Bottom Sheet
description: A draggable React Native bottom sheet with three snap points and rubber-banding, tracking a grocery courier over a hand-drawn street map with a live route.

props.name: items
props.description: Order lines with quantity and price.

name: Assistant Chat
description: A React Native chat with an AI plant-care assistant: grouped bubbles with tails, an animated typing indicator, quick-reply chips and a live composer.

props.name: fallbackReplies
props.description: Canned replies used in order for typed messages.

name: Night Sky Paywall
description: A React Native subscription paywall for a sleep app: a drawn moon over hills, checked benefits, annual and monthly plan cards with a savings tag, and trial copy.

name: Swipe Inbox
description: A React Native inbox whose rows swipe left to archive or delete and right to pin, with snap points, a full-swipe delete and an undo toast.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows: sender, subject, preview, time, unread, pinned.

props.name: undoWindow
props.description: Milliseconds the undo toast stays up.

props.name: hint
props.description: Nudge the first row on mount to teach the gesture.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Fired when a row is deleted; Undo restores it locally.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when a row is tapped.

name: Wallet Card Stack
description: A React Native wallet of payment, membership, coffee and transit cards drawn from layered shapes. Tap one to lift it and open its activity.
usage:
import { MobileWalletStack } from "@/components/design-for-ai/native/mobile-wallet-stack";

<MobileWalletStack cards={myCards} onAdd={() => navigation.navigate("AddCard")} />

props.name: cards
props.description: Cards with art style, wordmark, type, details and transactions.

name: Comparison Matrix
description: A full plan comparison table with a sticky price header, collapsible feature groups, tooltips and a teal recommended column that becomes a plan switcher on mobile.
usage:
import { PricingComparisonMatrix } from "@/components/design-for-ai/pricing-comparison-matrix";

<PricingComparisonMatrix
  plans={plans}        // { id, name, price, unit, blurb, cta }[]
  groups={groups}      // { name, features: { name, hint?, values }[] }[]
  recommendedId="team"
/>

props.name: plans
props.description: Plans in column order: id, name, price, unit, blurb, cta.

props.name: groups
props.description: Collapsible feature groups; values are boolean or a string per plan.

props.name: recommendedId
props.description: Plan id that gets the highlighted column.

name: Receipt Pricing
description: An isolated pricing block: tear-off licence tickets, a thermal-printed receipt that prints each plan line by line, and a buy button that counts to the total.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the block (visually hidden).

props.name: options
props.description: One receipt per licence: id, tab label and caption, total, licence and order codes, line items, summary rows and a CTA.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark printed at the top of the receipt.

props.name: stamp
props.description: Red rubber stamp across the total.

props.name: thanks
props.description: Sign-off at the foot of the receipt.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the outer block (max width 420px, centred).

name: Route Globe
description: A dotted Three.js globe built from real coastlines, with comet arcs flying between cities, pulsing markers, a soft atmosphere and drag-to-spin inertia.

props.name: routes
props.type: { from: [lat, lon]; to: [lat, lon]; fromLabel?: string; toLabel?: string }[]
props.description: Great-circle arcs with a travelling comet. Unique endpoints get a pulsing marker; labels show on hover or tap.

props.name: colors
props.type: { dots?: string; arc?: string; glow?: string }
props.description: Land dots, the accent for arcs, markers and twinkles, and the atmosphere.

props.name: focus
props.description: Latitude and longitude that face the camera on mount.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for rotation and comet speed; 0 stops auto-rotation.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag to spin with inertia and tilt.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the host element, which fills its parent.

name: Holo Metal Card
description: A brushed-metal membership card in Three.js with a thin-film foil shader, etched type and studio reflections. It tilts on a spring and flips on click.
usage: import { ThreeHoloCard } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-holo-card";

props.name: issuer
props.description: Issuer wordmark, top left of the front.

props.name: tier
props.description: Tier name, set in italic serif.

props.name: holder
props.description: Cardholder name, upper-cased on the card.

props.name: number
props.description: Full number on the back; the front shows the last four.

props.name: finePrint
props.description: Two lines of fine print on the back.

props.name: finish
props.description: Metal finish: base reflectance, edge polish and etch colour.

props.name: side
props.description: Controlled side. Omit to let the card manage it.

props.name: onSideChange
props.description: Called when the card is flipped.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer and device-orientation tilt. Flipping always works.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Particle Sphere
description: A Three.js sphere of 14,000 shader-lit particles breathing with simplex noise, wrapped in a tilted orbit. Pointer parallax, responsive, offscreen-aware.
usage: import { ThreeParticleSphere } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-particle-sphere";

props.name: colors
props.description: Rim highlight, mid-tone and core colours.

name: Voice Orb
description: A shader-built AI voice orb with thin-film sheen and a fresnel rim that breathes, listens to your mic, swirls while thinking and pulses word by word as it speaks.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit to let the built-in segmented control drive it.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called when the control or the mic button changes state.

props.name: name
props.description: The assistant’s name, used in the idle caption and labels.

props.name: captions
props.type: { idle?: string; listening?: string; thinking?: string }
props.description: Caption per state. Mic status lines (waiting, blocked, missing) override listening.

props.name: speakingLines
props.description: Lines voiced by the synthetic speech envelope; the caption lights up word by word in sync with the pulses.

props.name: tones
props.type: Partial<Record<VoiceOrbState, { deep?: string; rim?: string; accent?: string }>>
props.default: amber idle, coral listening, teal thinking, honey speaking
props.description: Body, rim and accent colours per state. Blended, never snapped.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the state segmented control and the microphone button.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the eyebrow and caption under the orb.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tilt the orb gently toward the pointer.

name: Hover Work Index
description: A studio work index in huge display type. On desktop a cover card follows the cursor on springs and tilts with its velocity, while the other rows dim away.

props.name: projects
props.description: year, client, discipline, href, cover art key and accent colour.

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: Chip label on the floating card.
